name: first-principles
description: Derive auditable engineering decisions, harden repositories, and propose changes for review.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-led engineering from decision to review
interface.longDescription: Reframe engineering problems from current evidence and hard constraints, harden repositories against applicable production-grade quality bars, then publish auditable GitHub pull requests or GitLab merge requests.
defaultPrompt: Use $first-principles-engineering to derive the smallest defensible change from current evidence and hard constraints.
Use $repo-hardening to review this repository with early validation and evidence-backed fixes.
Use $propose-change to publish this change as an auditable GitHub pull request or GitLab merge request.
